name: config-file-groups
goal: One table per source config with typed values and cataloged modules under configs

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: One accessible table per source config, typed literal presentations, source-preserving value inspection, revision-scoped search, and plural configs ownership for every app config.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing groups matrix had one config per category and asserted only raw text. Extend its shared fixture with a second config and short array, and prove separate tables, literal types, filtering, and historical values at all three viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed bd8bfd043 before repair; record7bf6fe88032cc582c38e4887e8fcab86608e1fa99e370a50d23d30f7b64ebd49 retains the two-tables-expected, one-table-rendered failure and inspected desktop pixels.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus5.5 implemented per-file tables and typed cells. Moved20sources for10configs; preserved IDs/imports, raw inspection and historical values; updated static metadata, generator, audit and tenant guidance.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
